_readme: Swiss market context cards (recurring theme). Every card that describes regulation or market facts carries a verify note.

cards.title: IS-H lifecycle and migration
bullets: SAP has announced the end of IS-H maintenance (mainstream to end 2027, extended to 2030).
Swiss hospitals are selecting successors: Epic, other suites, or SAP partner solutions.
Migration work: data mapping, parallel run, interface rebuild, tariff logic, training.

verify.note: Confirm SAP maintenance dates and announced successor options.

cards.title: Epic in Switzerland
bullets: Early adopters include Luzerner Kantonsspital (2019) and Insel Gruppe Bern (2024).
Epic certification is only available through employer sponsorship – getting hired into a project is the entry ticket.
Swiss specifics (tariffs, insurers, cantons, German) must be configured locally – local process knowledge is scarce.

verify.note: Check current customer list and go-lives in recent news.

cards.title: TARDOC and outpatient flat rates
bullets: From 1 January 2026 TARDOC (single services) and outpatient flat rates replaced TARMED.
Impact: new tariff tables, invoice logic, coding of outpatient procedures, controlling.

verify.note: Tariff versions and flat-rate catalogue change regularly.

cards.title: EFAS – uniform financing
bullets: Accepted by Swiss voters in November 2024.
From 2028: inpatient and outpatient care financed by the same key (cantons and insurers); from 2032 long-term care included.
Impact on hospitals: billing flows, canton shares, controlling of treatment paths, strategy for outpatient shift.

verify.note: Implementation details and shares are set in ordinances. Verify dates and percentages.

cards.title: Interoperability: FHIR, EPD, SHIP, XML
bullets: FHIR-based Swiss exchange formats by eHealth Suisse (e.g. referrals, medication).
EPD (electronic patient record) is being reformed.
Insurer exchange: XML invoices (Forum Datenaustausch), intermediaries like MediData, electronic cost approvals (SHIP).

verify.note: Standards and EPD law evolve. Check current versions.

cards.title: What it means for your career
bullets: Short term: IS-H operations and migration roles stay in demand.
Medium term: Epic analysts, BAs and POs who know Swiss tariffs and processes.
Long term: revenue cycle and data roles (KPIs, automation, data quality).

verify.note: Check current job ads (jobs.ch, LinkedIn) for skills that appear repeatedly.
